::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 25. 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (2): P. 506
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](people/person_939.qmd) quite hope to write to you about the [Bethlehem](organizations/other_177.qmd) this week. I have the duplicates, but have not got time to read them at a sitting as I meant.

Will you kindly send the Cawnpore [notice](cmy_books/cmybook_59.qmd) to me. [Mr Trevelyan](people/person_1943.qmd) has just been in. He was much gratified by your estimate of his [book](other_books/otherbook_406.qmd).[^1] For long your books and name have been familiar and dear in their family.

Yours ever faithfully
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: CMY had written a review for *[Macmillan's Magazine](organizations/other_78.qmd)* of George Otto Trevelyan's book on the massacre at Cawnpore during the [[other:]Indian Mutiny].
